description: Read the latest weekly brief the pricing analyst wrote for your workspace: short claims, each citing the findings it rests on (every number checked against them), the findings themselves, and the proposals it recorded as pending approvals, each with the exact call that would apply it. The analyst never applies anything: whoever approves sends that call. brief is null before the first one. Needs a Last Price credential with routing read scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.
name: get_analyst_brief
